title: The Lost Fleet quest text says 'Pay the wreck-right at the Reeve's Pride to bargain the fleet quiet,' but no place called 'the Reeve's Pride' was ever found despite exhausting Gullhaven (quay, high street, chandlery, harbourmaster's house, Drowned Bell, Smugglers' Stair) and the whole shore-path loop (Coast Path/Cliff Path/Tide Pools/Salt Pan Flats/Bramble Hollow/Salt-Crust Flat/Spit/Mudflats/Kelp Line/Sunken Causeway). The quest was still 'Left undone' at the game's end.
where: Saltkerns / The Lost Fleet (this hold's grief)
